messages:
jordan: Observed slow memory growth on int8 KV runs for long-context profiles (~50k tokens). Repro on canary cluster A. Heap + slab map increasing steadily even after idle.

sophia: Yikes. Did you see any delta vs bf16 runs? numbers?

jordan: BF16 stable. INT8 saves ~2.4x memory but shows +8-12% slot churn and ~1-2% top1 accuracy drop in our eval suite. Profiling attached:

jordan: ```
trace: kv_evictions=12456
kv_inserts=24567
avg_page_live_ms=320
page_compactions=8
kernel=matmul_v2_prefetch
batch_size_hist=[1,2,2,8,8]
```

mateo: kernel selection stands out: matmul_v2_prefetch switching to non-prefetch variant under heavy singleflight. Leads to more small writes -> fragmentation.

linh: Could be batching heuristics too. Small batch ratio jumped from 12%->46% after rollout. That increases hotpage churn.

kevin: Any telemetry on slot residency? eviction_reason breakdown?

jordan: eviction_reason: pager (70%), compaction (20%), threshold (10%). Slot residency median down from 120s->40s.

sophia: Sounds like int8 pages are smaller so we pack more slots per page but kernel alignment leads to strided writes.

mateo: Quick fix idea: prefer stable-kernel for pages with >N reuses; add per-slot reuse counter and avoid prefetch->nonprefetch flip. Also tweak batching to coalesce short requests into micro-batches with 5-10ms wait.

linh: Agreed. micro-batch window + sticky kernel should reduce churn. But must measure latency p99 impact.

kevin: Can we simulate with the loadgen harness? run: ./perf/harness --model=redwood-3b-int8 --kv-warm=1 --batch-window=8ms --kernel=stable-prefetch

jordan: Running now on canary-2, baseline int8: mem_growth +1.9MB/min, with patches: +0.2MB/min. p99 +3ms, p50 unchanged. Accuracy diff reduced to ~0.3%.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: kv-kernel-sticky v1 -> 4 hosts.

sophia: Nice. Let's add telemetry flag for slot_reuse_count and a metric for kernel_switches per-page.

mateo: I'll open a PR for kernel flag and batching param. Also adding a small unit-test to assert no kernel switch on hot pages.

jordan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123

linh: Plan: 1) merge canary patch 2) run 24h stability 3) run eval suite for accuracy regression 4) promote.

kevin: +1 on rollout plan. schedule perf run tomorrow 06:00 UTC.

sophia: Thx team. Great triage.
